findings.finding: Single-file CLI is appropriate for the sandbox scope.
DES-v1 does not specify behavior for malformed JSON; REQ-003 would fail.
Keep reads on an explicit path argument; do not walk C:\.
Print a one-line error to stderr on invalid input.
Use the existing Cursor worker only for implementation; council itself is local.

approved_design.summary: CLI that reads a JSON array of {name, status}, prints a table, and exits non-zero on malformed JSON without walking other directories.
